mzdom.name: Mainz Cathedral
mzdom.slogan: Red sandstone towers that have watched the Rhine for a millennium.
mzdom.line: Consecrated on 29 August 1009, the cathedral burned down the very same day.

mzgutenberg.name: Gutenberg Museum
mzgutenberg.slogan: Where one man's movable type changed how the world reads.
mzgutenberg.line: The museum keeps two copies of the 42-line Gutenberg Bible side by side in a walk-in treasure vault.

wbkurhaus.name: Wiesbaden Kurhaus
wbkurhaus.slogan: A colonnade made for strolling off your spa water.
wbkurhaus.line: Its 129-metre colonnade is called the longest columned hall in Europe; Kaiser Wilhelm II opened the Kurhaus in 1907.

rgeberbach.name: Kloster Eberbach
rgeberbach.slogan: Cistercian silence and Rheingau wine behind thick stone walls.
rgeberbach.line: The abbey's church and dormitory served as the monastery interiors in the 1986 film The Name of the Rose.

rgniederwald.name: Niederwald Monument
rgniederwald.slogan: Germania stands guard over the vineyards and the Rhine bend.
rgniederwald.line: This 38-metre monument above Rüdesheim was inaugurated on 28 September 1883.
